tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Primary buttons, links, active nav state, focused input border.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Signal color reserved for advice, new insight and anything genuinely new — the one-click recommendation, the 'new insight' status. Never decorative: if it shows up everywhere it stops meaning anything.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warmth accent, used only for the 'needs attention' status — not a second primary color.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Approximated from the guideline's screenshots — no exact value was given in the source file. Covers the reject-candidate button, input error state and 'rejected' status. Confirm the real value and update this token before shipping.

tokens.name: surface-bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card and panel surface, sitting on surface-bg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on inputs, cards and dividers.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper copy on surface-bg or surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-bg or surface.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a teal fill (primary button, active nav).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on the danger fill (reject-candidate button).

tokens.name: status-passed
tokens.usage: 'Passed screening' status. Always paired with a circle mark — never color alone.

tokens.name: status-attention
tokens.usage: 'Needs attention' status. Always paired with a square mark.

tokens.name: status-rejected
tokens.usage: 'Rejected' status. Always paired with a triangle mark.

tokens.name: status-insight
tokens.usage: 'New insight' status. Always paired with a diamond mark.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy, UI and marketing.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numeric dashboard figures only — cost, percentage, days-in-phase. Never body text or headings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap — icon-to-label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default control padding, gap between closely related fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped sections within a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between distinct sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page-level top and bottom breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.
